messages:
denise: quick eyes on this PR please — https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4291 :eyes: touching KMS references + optional HSM wrapping flag. This affects secrets rotation, audit hooks. Need sec + infra approvals. plan: merge Tue 09:00 UTC unless concerns.

akash: skimmed the diff. looks small. two quick q's: 1) can we keep previous key material during rotation window (rollforward fallback)? 2) can you add a unit test for wrap/unwrap behavior?

jason: tagging in for sec review. @denise does this change audit log schema or just metadata flags?

denise: good q — audit storage schema NOT changed. we add a metadata field `wrapped_by_hsm: true|false` on the audit entry. snippet: ```diff
- func WrapKey(k []byte) ([]byte, error) {
-     // old logic
- }
+ func WrapKey(ctx context.Context, k []byte) ([]byte, error) {
+     if cfg.EnableHSM {
+         return hsmClient.Wrap(ctx, k)
+     }
+     return kmsClient.Encrypt(ctx, k)
+ }
```

security-oncall: FYI I'll be OOO tomorrow morning until 13:00 UTC — if you need an expedited review, DM me.

maria: couple nits: prefer env var name `KMS_ROTATION_KEY_ID` (explicit) instead of `KMS_KEY_ID`. also add a short changelog entry under `security/` so ops knows the new metadata key.

akash: still want that unit test for idempotent rewraps — saw a potencial race if two workers rewrap concurrently. can you add a test that simulates duplicate rewrap requests?

denise: pushed a follow-up commit: renamed env var, added unit test for concurrent rewrap, and added changelog. link auto-updated.

deploy-bot: CI checks passed: `ci/unit` ✅, `ci/integration` ✅, `ci/lint` ✅. perf tests queued.

jason: LGTM from sec with one tiny comment about error wrapping — left an inline. +1 on security once that comment addressed. :thumbsup:

maria: approved.

denise: thanks all. I'll hold merge until Thurs maintenance window (2026-03-19 02:00 UTC) so we can watch audit events. marking with `do-not-merge/hold`.

akash: noted and added a `post-merge-checklist` item to verify key rotation idempotency and audit entry presence.

denise: updated PR title + release-note. does anyone want to be cc'd for post-merge verification?

jason: I can verify audit entries + metadata after merge.

(End of thread)
